expert.text: CFOs will not get margin gains from isolated AI pilots; managing AI as a portfolio can add 10 margin points by 2029.
Worldwide AI spending of $2.7 trillion in 2026, up 49.5% year over year.

history.note: Placed when the radar moved to stable megatrends

lens.cio: Tie AI budgets to measured outcomes; spending has doubled while only a third see profit impact.
lens.ciso: Cap open-ended agent loops; runaway AI usage is also becoming an attack target.
lens.cto: Track cost per business outcome for each AI workflow, not cost per token.
lens.eng: Instrument every AI workflow for tokens, latency and outcome, and tune it before scaling.

line: Token prices keep falling, yet AI bills more than doubled because usage grew faster.
scope: AI spend and return. Not model selection.
